abstract: Although choriocarcinoma following a term pregnancy is an uncommon disease, it is important to identify these patients early. The time interval between delivery and onset of treatment is a crucial factor influencing prognosis. We present a case where the woman was delivered of a stillborn infant and histological examination of the placenta at first did not reveal the true diagnosis of choriocarcinoma. Due to persistent vaginal bleeding curettage was performed 11 weeks later establishing choriocarcinoma. In this particular case it was then possible to review the original material and to confirm the diagnosis in this specimen. The case is extraordinary since the placenta harbouring the primary tumour had been macroscopically and microscopically described and the material could be reviewed. Secondly the case underlines the diagnostic difficulties when examining a mature placenta.
abstract_ja: 正期妊娠後の絨毛癌は稀な疾患ですが、患者を早期に特定することが重要です。分娩から治療開始までの期間は予後に影響する決定的な因子です。死産児を分娩した女性の症例を提示します。胎盤の組織学的検査では当初は正しい診断に至りませんでしたが、持続する膣出血のため11週後に搔爬が行われ、絨毛癌と確定しました。この症例では、原発腫瘍を含む胎盤が肉眼的および顕微鏡的に記載されており、標本を再検討することができました。本症例は、成熟胎盤の検査における診断上の難しさも示しています。
